places.gq: The Community Mall at Peninsula, Business Bay, Dubai
places.d: 66,000 sq ft and 23 shops next to Peninsula Two: a supermarket, pharmacies, beauty salons, healthcare, everyday shops, cafés and restaurants.
The community's main street on the water: cafés, restaurants and shops along the Dubai Canal, from quick bites and boutique cafés to sit-down restaurants.
Gardens and a walking and cycling path along the canal edge, with views across the water.
The central square, with fountains and gardens, running from the roundabout down to the canal. The heart of the community, where everything meets.
Where the Plaza meets the Dubai Canal. RTA water taxis serve the canal; ask your agent for the nearest stop.
Courts for tennis and padel, open to the community.
A 3-on-3 basketball court next to the tennis courts.
Lawns and gardens in the middle of the eastern blocks: space for children to play and for a quiet walk.
The way in from Marasi Drive, which connects to Sheikh Zayed Road and First Al Khail Street.
Drop-off on the main boulevard, by Peninsula Two and the Community Mall.
Where the main boulevard meets the community's ring road and the Plaza begins.

unpinned.d: A skate park is part of the community's sports facilities.
Squash is among the community's courts.
A children's play area in the community gardens.
Family-friendly walking, running and cycling tracks run through the whole community.
Convenience dining, boutique cafés, craft eateries and restaurants, mostly along the promenade and in the Community Mall.
Each tower has its own pools (with kids' pools), a fully equipped gym and lounges. Peninsula Three adds a co-working space, a yoga deck and a Burj Khalifa viewing deck on floor 50.
